Timi radiates his love for animals, he was very direct and kind to us too
he works very thoroughly and beautifully, our dog immediately took him into his trust 🥰 …

We love Timi very much and are grateful to him for his patience and love! From a lost puppy, I always get back a beautiful, shapely and shiny poodle. I'm glad that I can finally entrust him to someone with a kind heart.

They are the best in the area!
We took our Westie to get a haircut and they were the only ones in our area who gave us what we asked for and our dog turned out perfect.
In short, great! Marcit is loved by my slightly hysterical Schapendoes. Since he is a long-haired dog, patience and expertise are needed. Here you have both. I am very happy to have found Marcit!
They are the best, the cutest and even though my baby is not easy, they treated him super well. Thank you!!!
I love it, I have two dogs, I take everything there. They are very nice.
They are very kind, they do a beautiful job! Our little yorkie is completely reborn! Thank you, Timi!
The best cosmetics for dogs! They are attentive to allergic skin and very kind!

I’ve known Kati for over four years now – and I’ve even followed her to her new salon because she’s simply the best! Since 2025, she’s been at her new location on Bartók Béla, and I couldn’t be happier with the move.

She’s absolutely wonderful with animals – caring, patient, and professional. My dog loves going to her and always comes home looking (and feeling!) amazing. I trust her completely and know my dog is in the best hands.

I can wholeheartedly and unconditionally recommend her to anyone looking for a groomer who truly understands and loves what she does. Thank you, Kati! 🐾
They are super attentive and do a very nice job, at fair prices. Kati trims our spaniel, she is very kind, attentive and does precise work
We have been going to Kati with our dog for years, we have always been satisfied with her work, and we will continue to go only to her in the future.

My cowardly dog ​​(who refuses to go down the stairs) was waiting for me, neatly manicured, smelling good, with a beautiful hairstyle when I went to pick him up. We immediately asked Kati for the next appointment!
They cut into the dog's neck, and they literally cut off its skin with a machine. Of course, they didn't mention it, it's a forgettable place!

They are super nice! We took Chucky to many beauticians before Besties. He always came home traumatized, but since we took him to Besties, his phobias have disappeared! Marci is very nice and patient with him!! I can only recommend her

After many attempts, finally a truly kind, animal-friendly, knowledgeable, patient dog groomer. With a 14-year-old dog like mine, I really have to be careful where I go. Next time I'll come here too :) Wonderful transformation ☺️
